y-m-70-01.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse wekutanga usina kururama mugadziriso yaMinjae.
y-m-70-01.title: Mhinduro yepoinzi pa parabola yakakanganisa kupi?
y-m-70-01.topic: Conic sections: definition ye parabola (focus, directrix) nedhuri
y-m-70-01.goal: Wana mutsetse une kukanganisa mumhinduro inoshandisa definition ye parabola (dhuri kuenda ku focus rakaenzana nedhuri kuenda ku directrix), tarisa mhinduro nenzira isingadzokorori kukanganisa kumwechete, uye uedze hukama hwakagadziriswa nemapoinzi chaiwo.
y-m-70-01.material: Dambudziko iri rinoda mapoinzi ese P pa parabola y²=12x apo dhuri PF kubva ku focus F kuenda ku P i 9. (Coordinate plane; yuniti yehurefu yasiiwa. y² inoverengwa 'y squared'.) Mhinduro yaMinjae inoonekwa padanho rekutanga.
y-m-70-01.prereq.0: Fungidzira kuti mudzidzi ari kutora elective course ye 'Geometry' yehigh school. 'H2' i danho rekunetsa nerekutsigira rebasa iri rekugadzira chete; hazvireve kuti Ministry of Education inopa course iyi kugiredhi rakati.
y-m-70-01.prereq.1: Focus (p, 0) ne directrix x=−p ye parabola y²=4px, netsanangudzo ye parabola
y-m-70-01.prereq.2: Dhuri pakati pemapoinzi maviri pa coordinate plane
y-m-70-01.s.s1.hint.0: Tarisa, mutsetse nemutsetse, kana mutsetse wega wega uchitevera chaizvo kubva pamutsetse unotangira pakarepo.
y-m-70-01.s.s1.hint.1: Maka −3 nepoinzi x=1 panumber line uye uverenge zvakananga dhuri pakati pavo, wobva wauenzanisa nemutengo waunowana nekuisa x=1 mu expression yemutsetse 3.
y-m-70-01.s.s1.line.0: y²=12x i parabola y²=4px ne p=3, saka focus i F(3, 0) uye directrix i x=−3.
y-m-70-01.s.s1.line.1: Kune poinzi P(x, y) pa parabola, dhuri PF kubva ku P kuenda ku focus rinoenzana nedhuri kubva ku P kuenda ku directrix.
y-m-70-01.s.s1.line.2: Dhuri kubva ku P kuenda ku directrix x=−3 i x−3.
y-m-70-01.s.s1.line.3: PF=9, saka x−3=9, ndiko kuti, x=12.
y-m-70-01.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse 3 wakaenda zvisizvo. Directrix i x=−3 uye mapoinzi ari pa parabola ane x≥0, saka P iri kurudyi kwe directrix. Saka dhuri pakati pe P ne directrix harisi x−3 asi x−(−3)=x+3. Kugadzirisa kunopa x+3=9, x=6, y²=72, saka P(6, 6√2) kana P(6, −6√2). Mitsetse 4 ne 5 i mhedzisiro dzakatora kukanganisa kwemutsetse 3.
y-m-70-01.s.s2.prompt: Nzira inobatsira zvikuru yekusimbisa kuti mhinduro yaMinjae P(12, 12) haisi mhinduro yenyaya ndeipi?
y-m-70-01.s.s2.hint.0: Kutarisa kunoreva kuisa mhinduro mu 'mamiriro anodiwa nenyaya', kwete mu 'zvakabuda nemhinduro'. Mamiriro enyaya aiva chii?
y-m-70-01.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora kukosha kwaunowana kana ukaverenga mamiriro iwayo zvakananga ne P(12, 12).
y-m-70-01.s.s2.o.a: Tevera uye unyore mhinduro yaMinjae kamwe zvakare kubva pakutanga kuti uone kana mhinduro imwe chete ichibuda
y-m-70-01.s.s2.r.a: Kudzokorora mhinduro imwe chete kunodzokorora kukanganisa kumwe chete. Hakusi kutarisa kwakazvimiririra kubva pamhinduro.
y-m-70-01.s.s2.o.b: Isa poinzi P(12, 12) yakawanikwa kuti uone kana ichigutsa y²=12x
y-m-70-01.s.s2.r.b: P(12, 12) chaizvo ipoinzi iri pa parabola. Kutarisa uku kunoratidza kuti hakuedzi chikamu chine kukanganisa (mamiriro emwero).
y-m-70-01.s.s2.o.c: Verenga mwero pakati pe P(12, 12) ne F(3, 0) uye utarise kana uri 9
y-m-70-01.s.s2.r.c: Pfungwa iyi inoedza zvakananga mamiriro anodiwa nenyaya uye zvakaparadzana nemhinduro.
y-m-70-01.s.s2.o.d: Sezvo mhinduro yakabuda zvakanaka ne integer coordinates, funga kuti pamwe yakarurama
y-m-70-01.s.s2.r.d: Kuva nyore hakusi umboo hwekururama. Hakutarisi kana mhinduro ichigutsa mamiriro anodiwa.
y-m-70-01.s.s2.explain: Mwero pakati pe P(12, 12) ne F(3, 0) ndi √(9²+12²)=√225=15, isiri 9. Kuti P iri pa parabola here kunopfuurwa kunyange nemhinduro yemhinduro yakashata, saka hakugoni kubata kukanganisa. Kuverenga mamiriro anodiwa nenyaya (PF=9) zvakananga uye zvakaparadzana nemhinduro ndiko kutarisa kwakazvimiririra.
y-m-70-01.s.s3.prompt: Ngatiedzei kana hukama hwakagadziriswa 'PF = x+3' hwakarurama. Tsvaga mapoinzi 2 P(x, y) pa parabola y²=12x apo x ne y zvose ndema integers, ane makosha e x akasiyana, uye kune poinzi imwe neimwe verenga uye unyore zvakananga mwero d kuenda ku F(3, 0) uchishandisa fomula yemwero pakati pemapoinzi maviri.
y-m-70-01.s.s3.hint.0: Mu y²=12x, tsvaga makosha e x senge x=3, 12, 27 apo 12x iri perfect square, uye utsvage y.
y-m-70-01.s.s3.hint.1: Ita square misiyano yema coordinates epoinzi yawakawana ne F(3, 0), uwedzere, utore square root, uye uienzanise ne x+3.
y-m-70-01.s.s3.fail.c2: Poinzi haisi pa parabola. Tarisa kana y squared yakaenzana ne12x.
y-m-70-01.s.s3.ok.c3: d yakaenzana nemwero kuenda ku F.
y-m-70-01.s.s3.fail.c3: d inosiyana nemwero pakati pe P ne F(3, 0). Verenga (x−3)²+y².
y-m-70-01.s.s3.explain: Semuenzaniso, pa (3, 6), d=6=3+3; pa (12, 12), d=15=12+3; pa (27, 18), d=30=27+3. Pamapoinzi ose PF=x+3 yakasimbiswa. Saka PF=9 inoitika pa x=6 chete, uye ipapo y²=72, saka mhinduro dzenyaya iyi hadzisi mapoinzi ane integer coordinates.

y-m-70-09.title: Kana mutsetse unosangana ne parabola papoinzi imwe, i tangent here?
y-m-70-09.prereq.0: Fungidzira kuti mudzidzi ari kutora elective course ye 'Geometry' yehigh school. 'H2' i danho rekunetsa nerekutsigira rebasa iri rekugadzira chete; hazvireve kuti Ministry of Education inopa course iyi kugiredhi rakati.
y-m-70-09.topic: Conic sections: nzvimbo dzeparabola nemutsetse, mitsetse inobata
y-m-70-09.goal: Tonga chirevo chokuti 'kana unosangana papoinzi imwe, mutsetse unobata' uchishandisa humbowo hwuri patafura uye utsvage muenzaniso unopikisa, vaka iwe pachako mapeya (m, n) anopa mitsetse inobata yeparabola, uye utsanangure nyaya isingagoni kuparadzaniswa nediscriminant.
y-m-70-09.material:
Pane parabola C: y²=4x nemutsetse l_m: y=mx+1 (m inhamba chaiyo). (y² inoverengwa "y sikweya".) Jisu akati, "Mutsetse unosangana neparabola papoinzi imwe chete mutsetse unobata." Mhedzisiro dzokuisa mutsetse muchirevo che C nokuderedza, nemapoinzi okusangana, ndidzi pazasi.
m | chirevo mushure mokuisa | kusangana
−1 | x²−6x+1=0 | mapoinzi maviri
0 | −4x+1=0 | poinzi imwe (1/4, 1)
1 | x²−2x+1=0 | poinzi imwe (1, 2)
2 | 4x²+1=0 | hapana
Cherechedza: Mutsetse unobata papoinzi (x₁, y₁) pa C ndi y₁·y=2(x+x₁) (fomula yomutsetse unobata).
y-m-70-09.thinking.1: Kugadzira mamiriro omutsetse unobata nokuvaka mienzaniso yakati wandei
y-m-70-09.prereq.1: Mutsetse unobata y₁y=2(x+x₁) papoinzi (x₁, y₁) paparabola y²=4x
y-m-70-09.s.s1.prompt: Tonga chirevo chaJisu uchishandisa tafura nenoti sehumbowo.
y-m-70-09.s.s1.hint.0: Kumitsetse miviri iri patafura inosangana papoinzi imwe (m=0, m=1), tsvaga mutsetse unobata papoinzi yokusangana yega yega nefomula yomutsetse unobata uye uienzanise nemutsetse iwoyo.
y-m-70-09.s.s1.hint.1: Dhirowa mufananidzo uye uenzanise kuti mutsetse wega wega wakaratidzirwa sei maererano nechimiro cheparabola.
y-m-70-09.s.s1.o.a: Zvakarurama. Patafura, mitsetse inosangana papoinzi imwe (m=0, m=1) yose mitsetse inobata
y-m-70-09.s.s1.r.a: Hauna kutarisa kana mutsetse we m=0 uri mumwe chete nomutsetse unobata pa (1/4, 1).
y-m-70-09.s.s1.o.b: Zvakanganisa. Mutsetse une m=0 unosangana papoinzi imwe asi haisi mutsetse unobata.
y-m-70-09.s.s1.r.b: Uku kutonga kwakawana nyaya imwe inoputsa chirevo uye kwakatarisawo chikonzero (chakasiyana nomutsetse unobata).
y-m-70-09.s.s1.o.c: Hazvigoni kutongwa. Tafura ine mitsetse mina chete.
y-m-70-09.s.s1.r.c: Pasinei nokuti mitsetse ingani, muenzaniso mumwe unopikisa unoputsa "kana unosangana papoinzi imwe chete, mutsetse unobata".
y-m-70-09.s.s1.o.d: Zvakanganisa. Mutsetse unobata unogara uchisangana neparabola pamapoinzi maviri
y-m-70-09.s.s1.r.d: Uku kutonga kunosiyana netsananguro yokuti mutsetse unobata unobata papoinzi imwe.
y-m-70-09.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse y=1 ne m=0 unosangana na C papoinzi imwe (1/4, 1), asi mutsetse unobata papoinzi iyoyo ndi y=2x+1/2, saka unosiyana na y=1. Mutsetse y=1 unofanana neaxis (axis ye x) yeparabola, saka kunyange unosangana papoinzi imwe, haisi mutsetse unobata. Muenzaniso mumwe unopikisa unoita kuti chirevo chaJisu chisave chechokwadi. Kune rimwe divi, m=1 yakafanana nomutsetse unobata y=x+1, saka mutsetse unobata.
y-m-70-09.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira mapeya 3 (m, n), ane m dzakasiyana, umo mutsetse y=mx+n uri mutsetse unobata weparabola y²=4x. (Bvisa mitsetse inofanana neaxis neine chimiro x=k. Unogona kushandisa madhesimali.)
y-m-70-09.s.s2.hint.0: Isa y=mx+n muna y²=4x uye ugadzire chirevo che x. Che quadratic here?
y-m-70-09.s.s2.hint.1: Funga kuti mamiriro api emhinduro dzechirevo ichi anoenderana nokubata, uye ugadzire chirevo uchishandisa discriminant.
y-m-70-09.s.s2.fail.c1: Kana m=0, mutsetse unofanana neaxis yeparabola, saka haisi mutsetse unobata.
y-m-70-09.s.s2.fail.c2: Isa y=mx+n muna y²=4x kugadzira chirevo che quadratic che x, uye utarise mamiriro okuti chive nomudzi wakapetwa.
y-m-70-09.s.s2.explain: Kurongedza zvakare (mx+n)²=4x kunopa m²x²+(2mn−4)x+n²=0, uye kubva pa discriminant (2mn−4)²−4m²n²=16−16mn=0 tinowana mn=1. Ndiko kuti, y=mx+1/m (m≠0) mutsetse unobata. Mienzaniso: (1, 1), (2, 1/2), (−1, −1). x=0 (aksi ye y) haina chimiro y=mx+n, asi ndiyo mutsetse unobata pavertex.
y-m-70-09.s.s3.prompt: Kumutsetse se y=1 unosangana neparabola papoinzi imwe asi usiri mutsetse unobata, unopikisana sei nenzira yokutarisa mamiriro okubata nediscriminant mushure mokuisa? Tsanangura pfupi.
y-m-70-09.s.s3.hint.0: Tarisa kuti chirevo chakaiswa −4x+1=0 chine degree ipi kana m=0.
y-m-70-09.s.s3.hint.1: Enzanisa kuti chirevo chinofanira kuva nedegree ipi kuti discriminant ikwanise kutaura nezve 'mudzi wakapetwa'.
y-m-70-09.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ndakataura here kuti kuna m=0 chirevo chemutsetse, kwete che quadratic?
y-m-70-09.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ndakafunga here kuti sei mutsetse unofanana neaxis wakakosha kuparabola chete?
y-m-70-09.s.s3.model.0: Kana m=0, chirevo chakaiswa chemutsetse uye chine mhinduro imwe chete. Munyaya iyi haugoni kushandisa discriminant kutsvaga mudzi wakapetwa, uye mutsetse uyu unofanana neaxis, saka kunyange unosangana papoinzi imwe, haisi mutsetse unobata.
y-m-70-09.s.s3.model.1: Discriminant ye 0 inoreva kuti chirevo che quadratic chine mudzi wakapetwa, saka mutsetse unobata. Mutsetse unofanana neaxis unopa chirevo chemutsetse, saka mamiriro e discriminant haashande, asi unosangana papoinzi imwe. Saka kusangana papoinzi imwe hakuiti kuti ive mutsetse unobata.
y-m-70-09.s.s3.modelNote.1: Mhinduro inotaura pfungwa yokutanga ye discriminant

y-m-70-03.title: Mutsara une slope imwe chete ne asymptote haumbosangani ne hyperbola here?
y-m-70-03.topic: Conic sections: nzvimbo dze asymptotes dze hyperbola nemutsara
y-m-70-03.goal: Edza kupfuvura kwakavakwa kubva pakuisa asymptote imwe nemitsara yakawanda uye chinja kutonga kwako, wozoshandisa mhedzisiro kugadzira iwe pachako mienzaniso yemitsara ine slope imwe chete.
y-m-70-03.material: Ma asymptotes e hyperbola H: x²/4 − y²/9 = 1 (verenga: x squared over 4 minus y squared over 9 equals 1) ndi y=(3/2)x ne y=−(3/2)x. Soyoung akati: “Mutsara une slope imwe chete ne asymptote haumbosangani ne H. Asymptote inongoswedera padhuze ne H pasina kuibata.” Ngationgororei chirevo chaSoyoung nekutarisa zvinyorwa zviri pazasi rimwe panguva.
y-m-70-03.prereq.1: Ma asymptotes y=±(b/a)x e hyperbola x²/a²−y²/b²=1
y-m-70-03.prereq.2: Kuisa equation yemutsara mu equation ye hyperbola nekuipfupisa
y-m-70-03.s.s1.prompt: Uchitarisa zvinyorwa danho nedanho, sarudza kutonga kwako kwazvino nezve chirevo chaSoyoung.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.hint.0: Siyanisa kana zvose zvatosimbiswa kusvika zvino ndi 'asymptote pachayo' kana mitsara yose ine slope imwe chete.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.hint.1: Funga kuti chii chinoitika kana ukaisa zvakananga mutsara mumwe une slope imwe chete asi usiri asymptote, senge y=(3/2)x+1.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Kuisa asymptote y=(3/2)x mu equation ye H kunopa x²/4 − ((3/2)x)²/9 = x²/4 − x²/4 = 0, iri 0 chero x iri chii. Haigoni kuva 1, saka asymptote haisangani ne H.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Uchiona zvinyorwa izvi, kutonga kwako ndekupi nezve chirevo chaSoyoung (mutsara wose une slope imwe chete haumbosangani ne H)?
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Zvasimbiswa kuti asymptote pachayo haisangani ne H. Asi chirevo chaSoyoung chinoreva mitsara yose ine slope imwe chete, saka mimwe mitsara haisati yaedzwa.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Ndinofunga kuti chakarurama, asi asymptote imwe chete ndiyo yatariswa, saka chivimbo changu chakaneta
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wakasimbisa kuti asymptote pachayo haisangani ne H. Hausati waedza mimwe mitsara ine slope imwe chete.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Nguva yakanyanya kukurumidza kutonga. Mimwe mitsara ine slope imwe chete inofanira kuedzwawo
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Chirevo chinoreva 'mitsara yose ine slope imwe chete'. Unoziva kuti mutsara waonekwa kusvika zvino ndiwo mumwe chete wavo.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Chakashata. Mutsara wose une slope imwe chete unosangana ne H
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Izvi hazvienderani nezvinyorwa zvekuti asymptote haisangani. Kutonga kwakadanwa nenzira yakapesana pasina umboo.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Kuisa mutsara y=(3/2)x+1, une slope imwe chete, mu equation ye H kunopa x²/4 − ((3/2)x+1)²/9 = −x/3 − 1/9 = 1. Saka x=−10/3, y=(3/2)(−10/3)+1=−4, uye inosangana ne H papoinzi (−10/3, −4). (Tarisa: (100/9)/4 − 16/9 = 25/9 − 16/9 = 1)
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Uchiona zvinyorwa izvi zvitsva, kutonga kwako ndekupi nezve chirevo chaSoyoung?
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Poinzi (−10/3, −4) inogutsa zvose equation ye H neequation yemutsara, saka muenzaniso unopikisa. Muenzaniso mumwe unopikisa unoita kuti kupfuvura kwaSoyoung kuve kwenhema.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Kuverenga kunofanira kuva kwakashata. Kana slope yakafanana ne asymptote, havagoni kusangana
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Uku kutonga kunoedza kuchengeta kutenda kwekutanga pasina kuita iwe pachako kuverenga kwekutarisa (kana poinzi ichigutsa equation ye H).
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Mutsara uyu haugoni kuva muenzaniso unopikisa nekuti haina slope yakafanana ne asymptote
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Slope ye y=(3/2)x+1 ndi3/2, yakafanana ne asymptote. Tarisazve mamiriro ekuva muenzaniso unopikisa.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Chirevo chaSoyoung chenhema. Pane mutsara une slope imwe chete unosangana ne H
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Uku kutonga kwekuti muenzaniso mumwe unopikisa wakaputsa 'kana slope yakafanana, haumbosangani'.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Zvakajairika, kuisa y=(3/2)x+k kunopa −(k/3)x − k²/9 = 1, iri linear equation mu x. Kana k=0 havasangani; kana k≠0, x=−(k²+9)/(3k) inotarwa sekukosha kumwe chete, saka vanosangana papoinzi imwe chete.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ungagadzirisa sei chirevo chaSoyoung kuita mutsara wakarurama?
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Vose b ne d zvechokwadi. b inotaurawo kuti mutsara upi unoenda munyaya ipi (k=0 kana k≠0), nepo d ichingotaura mhedzisiro dzinogoneka.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Mutsara une slope imwe chete unogara uchisangana ne H pamapoinzi maviri
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Kuti mapoinzi maviri aonekwe, equation yakaiswa inofanira kuva quadratic equation. Mune zvinyorwa zviri pamusoro, equation yaiva linear.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Pakati pemitsara ine slope imwe chete, asymptote pachayo chete haisangani ne H, uye yasara inosangana nayo papoinzi imwe
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wakatsanangura nyaya dzose nekuparadzanisa kuita k=0 ne k≠0.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Soyoung akarurama. Muenzaniso unopikisa wakabva pakukanganisa kuverenga
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wakatora mhedzisiro yakatariswa mumadanho maviri sekukanganisa.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Mutsara une slope imwe chete kana usingasangani ne H kana unosangana nayo papoinzi imwe (haumbosangani pamapoinzi maviri)
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Ichi chirevo chechokwadi chinobata nyaya dzose. Hachitauri kuti nyaya ipi inoenda kupi.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.reflect: Pakutanga waigona kutenda 'hapana inosangana' kubva pa asymptote imwe, asi kupfuvura kunonetsa kuva nechokwadi kubva panyaya imwe chete. Muchinyorwa chinotevera, kana mutsara mumwe une slope imwe chete wakasangana ne H, kupfuvura kwakaputsika, uye chinyorwa chekupedzisira chakaratidza chaizvo 'kana vasingasangani'. y-m-70-08.title: Mumvuri wepanera yakatsvedzereka: nzvimbo yayo inoteerera mutemo upi?
y-m-70-08.topic: Zvakasimba muspace: nzvimbo yeorthogonal projection nedihedral angle
y-m-70-08.goal: Tsvaga imwe neimwe mitemo yakawanda inogoneka nedata rekuyera uye ugadzirise kuvimba kwako, uye utsanangure nerectangle kuti nei nzvimbo yeorthogonal projection i cosθ nguva yekutanga.
y-m-70-08.material: Pane panera yezuva yesquare ine hurefu hwedivi 6 m. Yakaiswa nedivi rimwe parallel nepasi (rakachinjika), uye panera inotsvedzereka kutenderera divi iroro seaxis; rudaidza kona yainoita nepasi θ. Tichifungidzira kuti chiedza chezuva chinodonha perpendicular nepasi, tinotarisa nhanho nenhanho data rekuyera nzvimbo S(θ) yemumvuri (orthogonal projection) pasi. Pane mitemo mitatu inogoneka. (가) S=36·cosθ, (나) S=36·(1−θ/90°), (다) S=36·cos²θ. (cos inoverengwa 'cosine', uye cos²θ inoverengwa 'cosine theta squared'.)

y-m-70-08.prereq.2: Trigonometric ratio cosθ nekukosha kwayo pamakona akakosha (0°, 45°, 60°, 90°)
y-m-70-08.s.s1.prompt: Kutarisa data nhanho nenhanho, sarudza kutonga kwako kwazvino nezvemitemo mitatu inogoneka.
y-m-70-08.s.s1.hint.0: Enzanisa patafura kukosha kwaunowana nokuisa θ mumusarudzwa wega wega nekukosha kwakayerwa.
y-m-70-08.s.s1.hint.1: Paradzanisa θ umo vasarudzwa vatatu vanopa kukosha kwakafanana ne θ umo vanopa kukosha kwakasiyana.
y-m-70-08.s.s1.st.0.info: Pa θ=0° (yakarara), S=36 m² yakayerwa, uye pa θ=90° (yakamira), S=0 m².

y-m-70-10.title: Kana mutsetse wakananga kumitsetse miviri yakasiyana muplane, wakananga kuplane here?
y-m-70-10.topic: Zvinhu zvakasimba muchadenga: kuenderana kwakananga kwemutsetse neplane (kunoratidzwa nema vector enzira)
y-m-70-10.goal: Tsvaga mamiriro ari kushaikwa muchirevo chokuti 'kana mutsetse wakananga kumitsetse miviri yakasiyana muplane, wakananga kuplane', vaka muenzaniso unopikisa uchishandisa macoordinate iwe pachako, uye utsanangure kuti sei mamiriro iwayo anodikanwa.
y-m-70-10.material: Mumacoordinate echadenga plane α ndi z=0 (xy-plane). Ngati vector yenzira yemutsetse l ive d=(a, b, c) (isiri vector zero), uye ngatibvumirane kuti mitsetse miviri yakananga kunoreva kuti dot product yema vector enzira ayo ndi 0 (tinotonga nenzira kunyange kana vasingasangani). Mudzidzi akati, “Kana mutsetse l wakananga kumitsetse miviri yakasiyana m₁ ne m₂ muplane α, saka l wakananga ku α.” Vector yenzira ye m₁ ndi (1, 0, 0).
y-m-70-10.thinking.2: Kutsanangura kuti sei mamiriro anodikanwa anodikanwa
y-m-70-10.prereq.2: Kana ma vector maviri akananga, dot product yawo ndi 0
y-m-70-10.prereq.3: Mitsetse miviri yakasiyana inopfuura napoinzi imwe muplane inosarudza plane
y-m-70-10.s.s1.prompt: Kuti chirevo ichi chigare chichishanda, chii chimwe chinodikanwa pamusoro pe m₁ ne m₂?
y-m-70-10.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora kuti ma vector enzira ndeapi kana m₁ ne m₂ dzichifanana.
y-m-70-10.s.s1.hint.1: Yedza nema vector enzira chaiwo kana pane mamiriro umo l kuva wakananga kunzira imwe chete kunokwana.
y-m-70-10.s.s1.r.a: l unosangana na α hauiti kuti ive wakananga. Mutsetse wakatsvedzera unosanganawo papoinzi imwe.
y-m-70-10.s.s1.o.b: Mumwe we m₁ ne m₂ unopfuura napa origin
y-m-70-10.s.s1.r.b: Poinzi iyo mutsetse unopfuura napo haina chokuita nevector yenzira yawo. Kungochinja nzvimbo kunopa nzira imwe chete.
y-m-70-10.s.s1.o.c: m₁ ne m₂ hadzifanani nomumwe nomumwe
y-m-70-10.s.s1.r.c: Pfungwa iyi yakaongorora kana mamiriro okuenderana kwakananga anofukidza nzira mbiri dzakasiyana muplane.
y-m-70-10.s.s1.o.d: Chikamu che z che vector yenzira ye l, c, hachisi 0
y-m-70-10.s.s1.r.d: Kunyange chikamu che z chisiri 0, l ungasava wakananga ku α. Funga (0, 1, 1).
y-m-70-10.s.s1.explain: Kana m₁ ne m₂ dzichifanana, pane nzira imwe chete, saka zvinokwana kuti l ive wakananga kunzira imwe. Saka mutsetse wakatsvedzera ungavawo wakananga kumitsetse yose miviri. Kana mitsetse miviri isingafanani, l wakananga kunzira mbiri dzakasiyana muplane, saka wakananga kunzira yega yega yeplane.
y-m-70-10.s.s2.prompt: Kana vector yenzira ye m₁ ndi (1, 0, 0) uye ye m₂ ndi (−2, 0, 0) (dzinofanana nomumwe nomumwe), gadzira ma vector enzira 3 (a, b, c), munzira dzakasiyana, dzemitsetse l yakananga kuna m₁ ne m₂ zvose asi isiri yakananga ku α. (Kana l yakananga ku α, vector yenzira ine chimiro (0, 0, c).)
y-m-70-10.s.s2.hint.0: Verenga dot product yega yega uye utange wasarudza mamiriro pa a.
y-m-70-10.s.s2.hint.1: Enzanisa nechimiro chakananga (0, 0, c) uye utsvage mamiriro api pa b anoita kuti isave yakananga.
y-m-70-10.s.s2.ok.c1: l yakananga kuna m₁ ne m₂ zvose.
y-m-70-10.s.s2.fail.c1: Madot product e (a, b, c) ne (1, 0, 0) ne (−2, 0, 0) haasi 0. Verenga madot product.
y-m-70-10.s.s2.fail.c2: Kana vector yenzira ine chimiro (0, 0, c), l yakananga ku α. b haifaniri kuva 0 kuti isave yakananga.
y-m-70-10.s.s2.explain: Dot product ye (1, 0, 0) ne (a, b, c) ndi a, uye ne (−2, 0, 0) ndi −2a, saka kana zvose zviri 0 saka a=0. Asi kuti (0, b, c) ive yakananga ku α tinoda b=0, saka kana b≠0 haina kunanga. Muenzaniso: (0, 1, 1) yakananga kumitsetse yose miviri asi haina kunanga ku α.

y-m-70-02.title: Tinogona kuziva mwero kubva papoinzi iri pa ellipse kuenda kune imwe focus here?
y-m-70-02.topic: Conic sections: tsananguro ye ellipse (sum yemwero kumafoci maviri)
y-m-70-02.goal: Dzidza kuti mwero kubva papoinzi imwe pa ellipse kuenda kune focus imwe oga haugoni kutara mwero kuenda kune imwe focus, taura kuti chii chimwe chinodiwa, uye utonge renji remwero unogoneka kana equation yapiwa.
y-m-70-02.material: Rega F ne F′ ive mafoci maviri e ellipse, uye P ive poinzi iri pa ellipse iyi. PF=7 chete ndiyo inozikanwa, uye unoda kutsvaga PF′. (Kureba kwose kuri mu unit imwe chete. x²/25 inoverengwa 'x squared over 25'.)
y-m-70-02.prereq.1: Tsananguro ye ellipse (sum yemwero kumafoci maviri yakagara)
y-m-70-02.prereq.2: Mafoci e ellipse x²/a²+y²/b²=1 (a>b>0) ndi (±c, 0), uye c²=a²−b²
y-m-70-02.s.s1.prompt: Kuti utare PF′ sekukosha kumwe chete, chii chimwe chinodiwa kunze kwezvinozikanwa zvino?
y-m-70-02.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora nemashoko kuti 'kukosha kwakagara' mutsananguro ye ellipse ndechii.
y-m-70-02.s.s1.hint.1: Chengeta PF=7 uye funga nezve ellipse ine sum 12 neimwe ine sum 20, uye uenzanise kuti PF′ yaizova chii mune imwe neimwe.
y-m-70-02.s.s1.o.a: Mwero FF′ pakati pemafoci maviri (kukosha uku chete ndiko kunowedzerwa)
y-m-70-02.s.s1.r.a: Kunyange kuziva mwero pakati pemafoci chete hakutari kuti sum yemwero ndeipi. Kunyange nemafoci akafanana pane ma ellipses akawanda ane saizi dzakasiyana.
y-m-70-02.s.s1.o.b: Y-coordinate yepoinzi P (kukosha uku chete ndiko kunowedzerwa)
y-m-70-02.s.s1.r.b: Coordinate imwe ye P oga haigoni kuudza nzvimbo yemafoci kana saizi ye ellipse. Hapana chakakwana kuverenga PF′.
y-m-70-02.s.s1.o.c: Urefu hwe major axis ye ellipse (kana equation ye ellipse)
y-m-70-02.s.s1.r.c: Uku ndiko kukosha kunoudza kuti sum yemwero kumafoci maviri yakatarwa pachii kune ellipse iyi.
y-m-70-02.s.s1.o.d: Hapana chimwe chinodiwa. PF′ ndi7 zvakare
y-m-70-02.s.s1.r.d: Hauzivi kuti ndeipi poinzi, asi wakatonga kuti iri pamwero wakaenzana kubva kumafoci ose maviri. P yaifanira kuva papi kuti PF=PF′?
y-m-70-02.s.s1.explain: PF+PF′ kukosha kumwe chete (urefu hwe major axis) papoinzi ipi neipi iri pa ellipse. Kana usingazivi kukosha uko, PF=7 oga haitari PF′. FF′ kana coordinate imwe ye P oga haitari sum zvakare, uye kuita PF′=PF kwakarurama chete kana P iri pamutsara perpendicular upfuura nepakati pemafoci maviri.
y-m-70-02.s.s2.prompt: Zvino ellipse x²/25 + y²/9 = 1 yapiwa. Mafoci ndi F(4, 0) ne F′(−4, 0). (Semi-major axis 5, semi-minor axis 3, 4²=5²−3²) Pamapoinzi api P e ellipse iyi PF=7 inogona kuitika?
y-m-70-02.s.s2.hint.0: Verenga PF pa vertex yekurudyi (5, 0) nepa vertex yekuruboshwe (−5, 0) kuti utsvage kukosha kudiki nekukuru kwe PF.
y-m-70-02.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa kana 7 iri mukati merenji iroro, wozotsvaga PF′ uchishandisa sum yemwero.
y-m-70-02.s.s2.r.a: Mhinduro iyi yakatora poinzi seiri pamwero wakaenzana kubva kumafoci ose maviri. Kune poinzi yakadaro, PF=PF′=5 yaizodiwa.
y-m-70-02.s.s2.r.b: Kutonga uku kwakashandisa urefu hwe major axis sesum yemwero.
y-m-70-02.s.s2.o.c: Hazvigoneki. PF haigoni kupfuura semi-major axis 5
y-m-70-02.s.s2.r.c: Semi-major axis ndiwo mwero kubva pakati kuenda ku vertex. Huwandu hwakasiyana nemwero kubva ku focus kuenda papoinzi iri pa ellipse.
y-m-70-02.s.s2.r.d: Inoratidzika sekunge wakaita urefu 10 hwe major axis kuenzana nemusiyano wemwero miviri, kwete sum.
y-m-70-02.s.s2.explain: Urefu hwe major axis ndi10, saka PF+PF′=10. PF ndi 5−4=1 pa vertex iri padhuze zvikuru uye 5+4=9 pa vertex iri kure zvikuru, saka inogona kutora kukosha kwose pakati pe1 ne9. 7 iri mukati merenji iroro, uye ipapo PF′=10−7=3.
y-m-70-02.s.s3.prompt: Pa ellipse imwe chete, gadzira mapeya akarongwa 3 (p, q) apo pane poinzi P chaiyo ine PF=p ne PF′=q. (Kutsiva p ne q kunoverengwa semuenzaniso mumwe chete. Unogona kushandisa ma decimals.)
y-m-70-02.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wanyora kuti p+q inofanira kuva chii, wozotarisa kana kusarudza p imwe kuchitara q.
y-m-70-02.s.s3.hint.1: Edza p iri pasi pe1 kana kupfuura 9 uye funga kana poinzi yakadaro ingava chaizvo pa ellipse.
y-m-70-02.s.s3.ok.c1: Sum yemwero miviri ndi10, urefu hwe major axis.
y-m-70-02.s.s3.fail.c1: p+q haisi 10. Sum yemwero kumafoci maviri e ellipse iyi yaiva chii?
y-m-70-02.s.s3.ok.c2: Iri mukati merenji remwero rinogona kuva nepoinzi iri pa ellipse.
y-m-70-02.s.s3.fail.c2: Mwero kubva papoinzi iri pa ellipse kuenda kune focus hauna kukwanisa kuva pasi pe1. Rangarira mwero pa vertex iri padhuze zvikuru.
y-m-70-02.s.s3.explain: p+q=10, uye kukosha kwe PF kunobva ku1 (vertex iri padhuze zvikuru) kusvika ku9 (vertex iri kure zvikuru), saka p ne q dzinofanira kuva 1 kana kupfuura. Mapeya ose akarongwa ane p pakati pe1 ne9, senge (3, 7), (5, 5) ne (1, 9), anogoneka.

y-m-70-04.title: Kana madot products akaenzana, mavectors maviri akaenzanawo here?
y-m-70-04.prereq.0: Fungidzira kuti mudzidzi ari kutora elective course ye 'Geometry' yehigh school. 'H2' i danho rekunetsa nerekutsigira rebasa iri rekugadzira chete; hazvireve kuti Ministry of Education inopa course iyi kugiredhi rakati.
y-m-70-04.topic: Plane vectors: zvimiro ze dot product nemienzaniso inopikisa
y-m-70-04.goal: Edza nemuenzaniso unopikisa kana mutemo wekubvisa unoshanda kunhamba ('kana ab=ac uye a≠0 saka b=c') uchishandawo ku dot product yema vectors, uye usarudze mamiriro anoita kuti ushande.
y-m-70-04.material: Kunhamba, kana a≠0 uye ab=ac, saka b=c. Jeonghyeok akafunga kuti ma vectors anoshanda nenzira imwe chete uye akati: “Kana a=(2, 1), kana a·b=a·c saka b=c.” (a·b ndiyo dot product ye a ne b, ndiko kuti kukosha kwaunowana nekuwedzera ma components uye uchiawedzera. Ma vectors ose ari pa coordinate plane.)
y-m-70-04.thinking.0: Kupokana kuti mutemo wenhamba unogona kutamiswa kuzvimwe zvinhu
y-m-70-04.thinking.1: Kugadzira iwe pachako muenzaniso unopikisa unogutsa mamiriro
y-m-70-04.prereq.1: Component form ye plane vectors ne dot product a·b=a₁b₁+a₂b₂
y-m-70-04.prereq.2: Zvimiro ze dot product kana ma vectors maviri ari parallel kana perpendicular
y-m-70-04.s.s1.prompt: Kuti uzive kana chirevo chaJeonghyeok chinogara chichishanda, (b, c) ipi yaizobatsira zvikuru kuedza?
y-m-70-04.s.s1.hint.0: Kana chirevo chine chimiro che 'kana mamiriro saka mhedziso', muenzaniso unoputsa chirevo unofanira kugutsa chii uye kuputsa chii, mamiriro kana mhedziso?
y-m-70-04.s.s1.hint.1: Tanga wasarudza vector imwe ine dot product ne a=(2, 1) inozikanwa, wozochinja ma components ayo uye utsvage imwe vector ine dot product inoramba yakadaro.
y-m-70-04.s.s1.o.a: Edza mapeya mazhinji apo b ne c ndiyo vector imwe chete
y-m-70-04.s.s1.r.a: Kana b=c, a·b=a·c inogara ichishanda. Aya haasi mapeya anogona kuputsa chirevo.
y-m-70-04.s.s1.o.b: Edza ma vectors ane nzira imwe chete ne a chete
y-m-70-04.s.s1.r.b: Uri kuedza nyaya yakasiyana chete. Kunyange kana ichishanda ipapo, haugoni kuziva nezvenyaya dzimwe.
y-m-70-04.s.s1.r.c: Saizi haina hukama hwakananga nekuti chirevo ichi chinoshanda here.
y-m-70-04.s.s1.o.d: Tsvaga mapeya ane a·b=a·c ne b≠c
y-m-70-04.s.s1.r.d: Sezvo chirevo chichiti 'inogara', pfungwa iyi inotsvaga peya inogutsa mamiriro asi ichipokana nemhedziso.
y-m-70-04.s.s1.explain: Chirevo che 'inogara' chinoputswa nepeya imwe chete inogutsa mamiriro (a·b=a·c) ichipokana nemhedziso (b=c). Saka chinhu chinobatsira zvikuru kutsvaga peya yakadaro iwe pachako.
y-m-70-04.s.s2.prompt: Kune a=(2, 1), gadzira mapeya 2 e ma vectors b=(b₁, b₂), c=(c₁, c₂) ane a·b=a·c asi b≠c. Mapeya maviri anofanira kuva ne b−c dzakasiyana (kutsiva b ne c, kana kuchinja chiratidzo che b−c chete, kunoverengwa semuenzaniso mumwe chete).
y-m-70-04.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wasarudza b imwe uye uverenge a·b.
y-m-70-04.s.s2.hint.1: Ona kuti a·c inochinja zvakadii kana ukachinja component imwe ye c, wozochinja imwe component zvakakodzera kudzosera dot product.
y-m-70-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Verenga a·b=2b₁+b₂ ne a·c=2c₁+c₂ zvakaparadzana. Makosha maviri haaenzani.
y-m-70-04.s.s2.fail.c2: b ne c mavector akafanana. Anofanira kusiyana kuti ave counterexample.
y-m-70-04.s.s2.explain: Muenzaniso: kana b=(1, 3), c=(2, 1), saka a·b=2+3=5 ne a·c=4+1=5 zvakaenzana asi b≠c. b−c inogara ichibuda muchimiro (t, −2t), nzira perpendicular ne a. Saka unogona kufambisa vector nehuwandu hwakaenzana munzira perpendicular ne a.
y-m-70-04.s.s3.prompt: Wakasimbisa kuti chirevo hachigari chichishanda. Sarudza mamiriro ose ekuwedzera anotevera anoita kuti 'kana a·b=a·c saka b=c' ishande. (a haisi zero vector.)
y-m-70-04.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora zvakare mamiriro ega ega seb−c inofanira kuva vector yerudzi rupi. a·(b−c)=0 zvinoreva chii?
y-m-70-04.s.s3.hint.1: Kumamiriro ega ega, tsvaga zvakananga peya ine b≠c kana a=(2, 1). Kana ukawana imwe, mamiriro iwayo haakwani.
y-m-70-04.s.s3.r.a: Kuva nehukuru hwakafanana hakuiti kuti ave vector imwe chete. Ongorora kana b=(1, 3), c=(3, −1) ichiita mamiriro kana a=(2, 1).
y-m-70-04.s.s3.o.b: a·b=a·c inoshanda kune vector a yega yega mu plane
y-m-70-04.s.s3.r.b: Pfungwa iyi inochinja a uchiisa mamiriro kuti b−c ive perpendicular kunzira dzose.
y-m-70-04.s.s3.r.c: Wakashaya kuti pane mavectors akawanda zvisingaperi perpendicular ne a pamutsetse mumwe. Semuenzaniso, fungidzira (1, −2) ne (2, −4).
y-m-70-04.s.s3.o.d: b ne c zvose zvine parallel ne a
y-m-70-04.s.s3.r.d: Pfungwa iyi inoshandisa chokwadi chekuti mavectors ari pamutsetse mumwe anogadzikwa imwe neimwe nehukuru hwawo (dot product).
y-m-70-04.s.s3.explain: Sezvo a·(b−c)=0, zvinokwana kuti b−c ive perpendicular ne a. (b) Kana ichishanda kune a yega yega, saka b−c iri perpendicular kunzira dzose, saka izero vector. (d) Kana b=sa ne c=ta, saka s|a|²=t|a|² inopa s=t. (a) Kana b=(1, 3), c=(3, −1), hukuru hwakaenzana uye a·b=a·c=5, asi b≠c. (c) (1, −2) ne (2, −4) zvose zviri perpendicular ne a saka dot product yavo i0, asi dzakasiyana pakati pazvo.
